hints.tr: Başlangıç kodu `random` ve sabit tohum kullanıyor; üstelik bazı parolalarda rakam çıkmıyor.
hints.en: The starter code uses `random` and a fixed seed; and some passwords get no digit.

hints.tr: `import secrets`; `while True:` içinde parolayı üret, üç türü `any(...)` ile denetle, tutuyorsa `return`.
hints.en: `import secrets`; inside `while True:` make the password, check the three kinds with `any(...)`, `return` it if they hold.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import secrets
import string

ALPHABET = string.ascii_letters + string.digits


def make_password(length):
    while True:
        password = "".join(secrets.choice(ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))
        if (any(c.islower() for c in password) and any(c.isupper() for c in password)
                and any(c.isdigit() for c in password)):
            return password


def classes_ok(p):
    return (any(c.islower() for c in p) and any(c.isupper() for c in p)
            and any(c.isdigit() for c in p))


passwords = [make_password(12) for _ in range(50)]
print("lengths ok:", all(len(p) == 12 for p in passwords))
print("classes ok:", all(classes_ok(p) for p in passwords))
print("unique:", len(set(passwords)))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import secrets
import string

ALPHABET = string.ascii_letters + string.digits


def make_password(length):
    while True:
        password = "".join(secrets.choice(ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))
        if (any(c.islower() for c in password) and any(c.isupper() for c in password)
                and any(c.isdigit() for c in password)):
            return password


def classes_ok(p):
    return (any(c.islower() for c in p) and any(c.isupper() for c in p)
            and any(c.isdigit() for c in p))


passwords = [make_password(12) for _ in range(50)]
print("lengths ok:", all(len(p) == 12 for p in passwords))
print("classes ok:", all(classes_ok(p) for p in passwords))
print("unique:", len(set(passwords)))
```

hint.tr: Parola üretirken tohum kullanılmaz: aynı tohum aynı parolaları verir.
hint.en: No seed when making passwords: the same seed gives the same passwords.
